summary: Nora can no longer tell the room a document exists when she never saved it. A reply with a link to one of her documents is held back unless that document is really in the room, and she is told why, so she says it was not made instead.
details: She can now look at eight pictures in one turn instead of four, so a document with pictures no longer runs out of calls before it is saved.
The guidance she always reads before writing a document now says it must be a finished reference, where pictures can come from, and that a document exists only once it is saved.
limitations: It checks that the linked document exists, not that it says what her reply claims.
A link to some other website is not checked.
No eval measures what a document contains, so the change is checked by reading back a live document.
